anomalies.observed: On the EPD_Driver sheet, C1 is drawn as 0.1 uF / 16 V, connected between the Display_Power_Switch rail and GND, immediately to the left of C2 (1 uF / 6.3 V) at the input of the boost stage (L1).
anomalies.expected: The specification places C1 in the group of PDI-reference 1 uF / 25 V capacitors ('C1/C5/C7/C8/C9/C10 = 1 uF/25 V'), so C1 should be 1 uF / 25 V.

evidence.quote: C1 0.1uF/16V  (EPD_Driver sheet, left of C2 1uF/6.3V, on the Display_Power_Switch / L1 input rail)
| C2 default: 1 µF/25 V | C1/C5/C7/C8/C9/C10 = 1 µF/25 V | Matches default |

anomalies.impact: The decoupling on the switched EPD supply rail is ~10x smaller than intended and the part is rated below the intended 25 V class; the e-paper panel's VDD/VDDIO rail may see more noise during boost switching, and the part is under-rated relative to the reference design.

parsed.summary: The only clear deviation from the specification found in the drawing is C1 on the EPD driver sheet, drawn as 0.1 uF/16 V while the spec lists it among the 1 uF/25 V PDI-reference capacitors; all other specified parts, values and connections (FAN53610 EN/MODE/FB wiring, L1/R1/C2/L2/C12/C13/R2 values, EPD signal mapping, S1-as-reset, barrel-jack battery disconnect) match the spec.
